opening.text: I've had a cough and trouble walking up stairs for 3 months. My muscles feel weak, but they get stronger once I've been active for a while, and climbing stairs gets easier. I work in construction, live in a two-story apartment without an elevator, and I've smoked a pack of cigarettes a day for 35 years.
